title: Blueberry and Dark Cocoa Smoothie
excerpt: Enjoy a creamy smoothie that combines the natural sweetness of fresh high-mountain blueberries with the intensity of dark cocoa. Perfect to revitalize your day in minutes.
imageAlt: Glass of creamy blueberry and dark cocoa smoothie garnished with whole blueberries and a sprinkle of cocoa powder.
steps: In the blender jar, pour the milk of your choice and the vanilla extract.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the cold lands of Guasca, and the two tablespoons of dark cocoa powder.
If you want to balance the intensity of the cocoa, add honey to taste.
Blend on medium speed for 1 minute until all the ingredients are fully combined.
Add the ice cubes and blend on high speed for 30 more seconds to give it a frosty, refreshing texture.
Serve right away in tall glasses and enjoy it fresh.
tips: For an even creamier texture without diluting the flavor with ice, freeze the Fresh Pick blueberries for a couple of hours before making the smoothie.
Keep your blueberries in the fridge in their original container, unwashed, until you are ready to use them.
